text: Hyperparameter search with Optuna, scored for the art track
description: train/search.py: one trial at a time (memory), each a short training run from the base's init with sampled loss weights and settings (lr, texture, style, edge, hole weight, observe, steps), scored by evaluate.py on 48 free-running steps: L1 relative to push-pull plus |log sharpness| and |log contrast| vs the footage. --arch also samples the layout (hidden width 4-32, mip levels 2-5) from scratch, which doubles as the lower-bounds sweep. Resumable sqlite study per base in runs/search/. Next: multi-objective (Pareto of look vs ms), pruning by intermediate validation, a human-in-the-loop rating from the pattern gallery as the score.

status.comment: search.py + train.style committed (4d5417d); queued after the cnn run: evaluate cnn and nodrop on 48 steps, then 12 trials x 250 its from nice-net.
